kiel-plon-preetz-morning-lakes.title: Kiel · Plön and Preetz Morning Lakes
kiel-plon-preetz-morning-lakes.slogan: Short, green and best before lake traffic arrives.
kiel-plon-preetz-morning-lakes.story: Short, green and best before lake traffic arrives. The best part sits around Preetz old town, Plön lake view, Bosau road, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Preetz old town → Plön lake view
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Bosau road → Back to Preetz old town
scenicChapters.narrative: 52 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.
